caption: The video captures a wide vista of layered karst mountain silhouettes in blue-teal tones rising above a thick, undulating sea of low clouds, with a darker vegetation-topped ridge protruding from the fog in the lower-right foreground beneath a pale sky. The camera holds fixed, so the peaks and the ridge remain locked in position throughout the excerpt. The cloud sea, however, is in continuous slow motion, its surface swirls and crests shifting shape and redistributing around the base of the ridge rather than moving as a rigid block. Wisps near the right ridge and in the central gap between cloud masses thin, thicken, and reconfigure gradually, revealing the fluid drift of the fog layer. This churn is underway at the first frame and still ongoing at the last, with no start or completion visible. The scene stays serene, the only change being the restless rearrangement of the clouds below the still mountains.
